facts.fact: ESCCOM, with the ICT ministry and ESWASA, launched the gazetted Eswatini National Addressing Standard (SZNS ISO 19160) on 16 July 2026, with implementation guidelines and field pilots in urban, rural and informal areas still to come.

SWZ.note: The document does not mention authentication or e-signature services.
The document does not mention a civil register to ID link.
The document gives no ID enrolment count or share.
The document does not mention a number given at birth.
The document does not mention who operates or owns the ID system.
The document names digital identity only as a future beneficiary, with no register keyed on the ID number.
The document does not describe the national ID system.

facts.fact: ESWASA turned ISO 19160-1:2015 (address information) into the gazetted national standard SZNS ISO 19160, launched on 16 July 2026.
